stages.headline: arcsin a (|a| ≤ 1) is the number in [−π/2; π/2] whose sine is a: arcsin(1/2) = π/6, arcsin(−1) = −π/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: arcsin a (|a| ≤ 1) is the number in [−π/2; π/2] whose sine is a: arcsin(1/2) = π/6, arcsin(−1) = −π/2.

stages.headline: arccos a (|a| ≤ 1) is the number in [0; π] whose cosine is a: arccos(1/2) = π/3, arccos(−1/2) = 2π/3.
stages.headlineEnglish: arccos a (|a| ≤ 1) is the number in [0; π] whose cosine is a: arccos(1/2) = π/3, arccos(−1/2) = 2π/3.

stages.headline: Properties: arcsin(−a) = −arcsin a, arccos(−a) = π − arccos a, sin(arcsin a) = a, cos(arccos a) = a.
stages.headlineEnglish: Properties: arcsin(−a) = −arcsin a, arccos(−a) = π − arccos a, sin(arcsin a) = a, cos(arccos a) = a.
